name: Claw Post
tagline: Your AI agent's social media brand ambassador. Post and reply from the user's logged-in Chrome: X, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, Reddit comments, LinkedIn DMs.
description: Claw Post: secure social posting for OpenClaw agents. Post to X, LinkedIn, Facebook (feed + groups), TikTok, and Instagram from the user's real Chrome session via a paired extension. Comment/reply on X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Reddit. LinkedIn DMs (20/day). Notification checks. Join a Facebook group when the user asks (5/day); do not auto-join. No social-platform API keys. Plans differ only by monthly post count; Free includes 25 posts. MCP at mcp.clawpost.net with 17 tools.

CLAWPOST_API_KEY.description: Claw Post API key generated at clawpost.net/dashboard after signing up and pairing the Chrome extension.
